purpose: Read-only comparison of chosen claim-v1 frozen subject_steps witnesses with retained first/final snapshots and stopped SQL rows.
method: Three already-stopped installations only; cleanup_complete and group_cleanup.complete were checked before reads.
Read three original 25,784-byte claim CAS files and the retained first/final ledger JSON files. No subject/model runtime was opened.

SQL verification selected only the two frozen subject_steps primary keys per database using mode=ro and PRAGMA query_only. A nonempty WAL without pre-existing SHM would be refused; all observed SHM files already existed.

Compare full SQL cell values after replacing updated_commit_seq with the same LocalSequence marker used by the canonical row engine. Compare data text exactly in SQL verification. Artifact snapshots decode JSON and their comparisons are semantic.
SHA-256 binds the observed raw claim bytes and retained ledger files. Declared original BLAKE3 refs are retained; BLAKE3 was not recomputed because the Python module was unavailable.
No source, model, installation state, score, failed denominator or control admission was modified.
conclusions: All three frozen tables contain exactly two rows: the immutable creator and the current successor. The creator's complete canonical cell vector and data text remain equal in the stopped SQL databases.

Among the frozen old-branch rows, only the successor changed: state preparing→awaiting_model, record_revision 1→2, active_request_id null→the retained second-request ID. All other data fields and canonical columns remain equal.
The final table also has one newly created step on the reconstructed branch; it was not in the original frozen table. This later addition is distinct from the old-branch successor change.

These retained rows are direct evidence of S0 progress after capture. The runtime error separately proves the complete subject_steps witness comparison failed. No transaction snapshot from the exact failing materialization is retained, so this audit does not claim the final table was the precise table read at failure or exclude additional transient differences.
The old second requests retain Unknown terminal outcomes and all three original protocol_passed=false / parent_exit=-15 results remain unchanged.
